name: Ride the Enoden
about: The ride's set for the user's approval before the ride is built (docs/LEARNINGS.md A8; docs/CITIES.md M1): the photographic KM1-2a to c, the car's far wall at 370 px to the metre, the kid standing in the aisle (the play lane at z = 0, on the car's floor). Game axes: x along the car (m), z away from the camera, front: the z of a model's face toward the camera.

placements.note: the car: its floor from just before the kid to its far wall 1.3 m behind the aisle, the benches (KM-B42)
the town passing behind the windows, its street 1 m below the car's floor; the ride slides it past and repeats it (KM-B43)
Yuigahama's platform outside the door at the first stop (KM-B44; Wadazuka's and Kamakura's at the next two)

people.note: the grandmother who boards at Yuigahama (give up your seat)

play.what: board: tap the card reader in time, before the door chime ends
ride: keep the ball still against the sway (the stick), hold KICK through a hard brake
the grandmother boards at Yuigahama: give up your seat for a bonus
get off: the next-stop display names each stop; press STOP at Kamakura's
